works.author: Phenomenon Labs for Phenomenon Studio
works.comment: 金融资讯产品 MarketSnack 落地页：居中式首屏、大标题配双按钮，浅蓝白底加亮蓝点缀、流光线条背景，下方还给了定价与移动端适配展示；金融类落地页的首屏信息层级与多端展示组合值得参考。
works.comment_en: Fintech landing page for MarketSnack: a centered hero with a big headline and dual CTAs, light blue-white surfaces with bright-blue accents over a flowing-line backdrop, plus pricing and mobile-adaptation sections below — a solid reference for hero hierarchy and multi-device presentation on finance landing pages.
works.title: Fintech Landing Page Design – MarketSnack

works.author: Permadi Satria Dewanto for Plainthing Studio
works.comment: AI 工作流自动化平台 Orvyn：深色多屏落地页拼贴，黑底配荧光绿点缀，中央节点式工作流图把自动化流程讲得很直观；AI 产品想讲清复杂流程时，这种“图示即卖点”的 Hero 值得借鉴。
works.comment_en: Orvyn, an AI workflow automation platform: a dark multi-screen landing collage in black with neon-green accents, where a central node-based workflow diagram makes the automation flow instantly legible — a good model for AI products that need the diagram itself to sell a complex process.
works.title: Orvyn — AI Workflow Automation Platform

works.author: Fahema Yesmin
works.comment: B2B 电商网站首页：白底配深绿与玫红点缀，顶部导航加搜索，浅蓝首屏下方是蓝紫绿三色品类卡片与商品网格；B2B 电商首页“搜索入口 + 品类卡 + 商品流”的标准骨架做得很干净。
works.comment_en: B2B e-commerce homepage: a white layout with dark-green and magenta accents, top navigation plus search, a light-blue hero followed by blue, purple and green category cards and a product grid — a clean take on the standard B2B homepage skeleton of search entry, category cards and product flow.
works.title: B2B Ecommerce Website

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 智能银行 App 与网页仪表盘：浅薄荷绿底的手持手机展示图，手机内是个人资料与总支出点状图表，两侧浮动交易卡片、绿色金额；“主界面 + 浮动交易卡”的展示构图，金融产品展示页可以直接抄。
works.comment_en: Smart banking app plus web dashboard: a mint-background phone showcase where the handset shows a profile and a total-spending dotted chart, flanked by floating transaction cards with green amounts — the main-screen-plus-floating-cards composition is directly reusable for fintech showcase pages.
works.title: Smart Banking App & Web Dashboard

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: 带 AI 的诊所管理 SaaS 仪表盘：浅暖灰底、黑白为主辅以柔和粉绿，顶部指标卡与折线图，前台看板与新建预约弹窗是亮点；医疗后台“指标 + 看板 + 快速新建”的三段式布局很值得抄。
works.comment_en: Clinic-management SaaS dashboard with AI: a light warm-gray layout in black and white with soft pink and green accents, metric cards and a line chart on top, and a front-desk board plus a new-appointment modal as highlights — the metrics-plus-board-plus-quick-create trio is a pattern worth stealing for healthcare back offices.
works.title: Healthcare Admin Dashboard – Clinic Management SaaS with AI

works.author: Awe Mobile App for Awe Design Studio
works.comment: 医生预约 App：淡紫渐变底、亮紫点缀、白色卡片，左侧是即将到来的预约卡片与专科图标网格，右侧是医生搜索、筛选与含评分价格的医生列表；预约类 App 从“我的预约”到“找医生”的双屏流程很完整。
works.comment_en: Doctor appointment app: a light-purple gradient backdrop with vivid purple accents and white cards — upcoming-appointment cards and a specialty icon grid on one screen, doctor search, filters and a rated, priced doctor list on the other; the two-screen flow from my appointments to finding a doctor feels complete.
works.title: Doctor Appointment App
